achieve_silver_justification: WhitePact has already earned the OpenSSF Best Practices Silver badge (project 14112): https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/14112/silver
bus_factor_justification: WhitePact is currently founder-led with one primary maintainer. Continuity documentation exists, but a second maintainer with equivalent project knowledge and operational ability has not yet been established; this criterion will not be marked Met until that is real. Re-checked 2026-08-29 via `git log --format='%ae' | sort -u` (3 email addresses, no evidence of a second independent maintainer). Governance evidence: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
contributors_unassociated_justification: The project does not currently have at least two unassociated significant contributors meeting the OpenSSF Gold definition. This is an organizational maturity requirement and cannot be satisfied by documentation or automation alone. Contributor history: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/graphs/contributors
copyright_per_file_justification: Re-verified 2026-08-29: `grep -rl SPDX-License-Identifier src/` finds 0 of 205 Python source files with per-file license/copyright headers. The repository has an MIT LICENSE with a project copyright notice, but source files do not yet consistently contain per-file copyright statements. Root license: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/LICENSE
license_per_file_justification: Re-verified 2026-08-29, same grep as copyright_per_file: 0/205 files. The repository is MIT licensed, but source files do not yet consistently carry per-file SPDX-License-Identifier statements. Root license: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_distributed_justification: WhitePact uses Git, a distributed version-control system, and the authoritative public repository is hosted at https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact
small_tasks_justification: WhitePact publicly identifies bounded starter work for new and casual contributors with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Example: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/issues/53 (carried forward from prior evidence; not re-fetched this session due to lack of network access -- see compliance/openssf/OPENSSF_GOLD_GAP_ANALYSIS.md for that caveat).
code_review_standards_justification: docs/CODE_REVIEW.md defines review scope, security review checks, and acceptance criteria while explicitly not claiming independent review history. NOTE: this file exists on the security/openssf-hardening branch (unmerged) as of 2026-08-29, not yet on main -- see compliance/openssf/OPENSSF_HARDENING_REPORT.md.
two_person_review_justification: WhitePact is currently maintained primarily by one person and cannot honestly demonstrate that at least 50% of proposed modifications before release were reviewed by a different person. required_approving_review_count is deliberately 0 on the main branch protection rule today (see compliance/OSPS_BASELINE_BRANCH_PROTECTION.md). This will only be marked Met after real independent review history satisfies the criterion.
build_reproducible_justification: Re-verified 2026-08-29 by locally replaying the security/openssf-hardening branch's reproducible-build.yml logic: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pinned to the commit timestamp, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, built twice with `python -m build`, SHA-256 digests of the resulting wheel and sdist compared with `diff -u` -- byte-for-byte identical across both builds. Workflow (unmerged, PR #52): https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/security/openssf-hardening/.github/workflows/reproducible-build.yml
test_invocation_justification: The full automated Python test suite is invoked using the standard pytest command; CONTRIBUTING.md documents the exact commands and CI runs pytest directly: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-tests
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs linting, typing, dependency auditing, tests with coverage, builds, Helm validation, accessibility checks, i18n checks for pull requests and relevant pushes. CI: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_branch_coverage80_justification: Re-measured 2026-08-29 (updated from a prior 80.19% figure dated 2026-08-17, since real feature code landed in between): fresh `pytest -q` run (3187 passed, 1 skipped, 1 flaky-timeout test that passed cleanly in isolation) + coverage.json totals give 83.32% pure branch coverage (2093/2512 branches), computed as covered_branches/num_branches via scripts/check_branch_coverage.py, isolated from the blended statement+branch 'Cover' percentage. See compliance/openssf/OPENSSF_MASTER_MATRIX.md.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: Newly measured 2026-08-29 -- this field was previously left unmeasured/unclaimed. Same fresh pytest run as test_branch_coverage80: coverage.json totals give 92.75% pure statement coverage (11494/12392 covered_lines/num_statements), computed the same way the (unmerged) scripts/check_statement_coverage.py on security/openssf-hardening computes it. See compliance/openssf/OPENSSF_GOLD_GAP_ANALYSIS.md for the full re-verification.
crypto_used_network_justification: Production deployment documentation requires secure HTTPS/TLS transport at the trusted ingress/reverse-proxy boundary; insecure public transport is not the documented production configuration: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/DEPLOYMENT.md
crypto_tls12_justification: WhitePact's documented production deployment supports TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3; a prior direct connection to whitepact.com:443 (2026-08-17) negotiated TLS 1.3. Not re-verified live this session (no outbound network access) -- see compliance/openssf/OPENSSF_HUMAN_REQUIREMENTS.md item 6 for the recommended live re-check. Deployment evidence: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/DEPLOYMENT.md
security_review_justification: WhitePact has a documented human security review/assurance process covering the security boundary, threat model, known gaps, and implemented mitigations. This is explicitly self-conducted and is not represented as an independent penetration test: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/compliance/INTERNAL_SECURITY_REVIEW.md
hardening_justification: The application implements defense-in-depth hardening including CSP/HSTS and related response headers, rate limiting, RBAC, tenant isolation, SSRF defenses, security scanning, and security regression tests. Security middleware evidence: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/src/responsibleai/dashboard/middleware.py
dynamic_analysis_justification: WhitePact executes its production code through an automated pytest suite with pure branch coverage at or above the OpenSSF 80% dynamic-analysis threshold (83.32% as re-measured 2026-08-29): https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/compliance/OPENSSF_DYNAMIC_ANALYSIS.md
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The automated pytest suite (3187 tests as of 2026-08-29) uses extensive runtime assertions across governance, authorization, API, MCP, persistence, and security behavior during CI testing: https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
